title: WP900 G10 minimal behavior-state split after executed trial identity sidechannel
target: F2-WP-900 generation 10 existing semantic mediator authority

current_dataflow_observation.binding_dependency: bind_independent_semantic_mediator_crossover currently reads state.trial_process_identity to build verifier-side crossover evidence even though execute_mediated_reentry_only does not need it.

minimal_repair_shape: Keep generation G10 and the existing mediator authority; do not create G11 or a second state/mediator authority.
Remove trial_process_identity from MediatedSemanticState and from MediatedSemanticState.as_dict()/sha256. The behavior-capable state should not carry source/trial/executor topology labels.

Keep source/trial identity comparison and topology evidence on the verifier/readback side. If admit_mediated_semantic_state still accepts a trial identity for verifier validation, do not persist it into the returned behavior state.

Change bind_independent_semantic_mediator_crossover so verifier-observed trial process identities arrive through a verifier-only argument/evidence surface rather than through MediatedSemanticState. Do not let that verifier-only surface enter execute_mediated_reentry_only or the child request.

Prefer canonical_semantic_json as the only public behavior-bearing state value. semantic_sha256/wire_sha256 may remain only if an executable test demonstrates they are deterministic functions of canonical_semantic_json and cannot encode trial/source/topology selectors; otherwise keep those digests verifier-side too.
Preserve factory-origin sealing, exact mediator.to_wire equality, source-event/runtime-witness binding, and direct-construction rejection.
required_adversarial_regressions: Enumerate every public field/key available on an admitted MediatedSemanticState before child launch; excluding canonical_semantic_json, no value may recover trial position, semantic class, arm/condition, source identity or treatment.
Assert trial_process_identity is absent from the behavior state and absent from behavioral executor input keys.

Construct position-coded verifier trial identities for ABBA and prove the returned behavior states are indistinguishable with respect to those identities except for the permitted canonical semantic value.
Preserve forged-wire rejection: a self-consistent caller-made canonical wire that differs from mediator.to_wire must still fail before behavior execution.
Preserve direct MediatedSemanticState construction rejection through factory origin sealing.
Preserve external payload/arm environment-hint resistance and fresh child execution.
Re-run targeted G8+G9+G10 CI plus deterministic release CI on one exact repaired head, then repeat independent ABI review before any VPS freeze.

runtime_gate_after_repair.required_topology: independently observed source -> verifier/trial -> executor process instances with anti-PID-reuse identity
runtime_gate_after_repair.required_binding: exact repaired source SHA + boot/process topology + exact trial wire digest + semantic result/readback + ABBA crossover
runtime_gate_after_repair.forbidden_shortcut: logical process labels or process-local factory seals alone do not establish target process independence

duplicate_authority_check: Review-only repair specification. No source/test/workflow/active-pointer mutation, no G11, no runtime dispatch and no second authority created.
next_exact_action: Existing G10 mutation owner implements the minimal behavior-state split, lands adversarial wrapper regressions, re-greens repository gates on one exact repaired head, then and only then freezes that new head for the existing VPS process-topology discriminator.
